article.title: The evolution of fault orientation in the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake sequence with a new long-term catalogue of seismicity and moment tensors
article.scientific_question: How does fault orientation evolve through the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence and its multi-year recovery when a long-term automatically detected, relocated and moment-tensor catalog is constructed?
article.sequence: Ridgecrest catalog spanning April 2019 through May 2023, including foreshock, mainshock, aftershocks and long-term recovery.
article.catalog_relationship: Constructs a long-term hypocenter catalog and a quality-filtered moment-tensor product; local CaltechDATA Version 2 files are related to, but not proven byte-identical with, the article's cited release.

evidence.locator: Catalog-construction workflow; Reported products and limitations

catalog.name: Atterholt–Wilding–Ross long-term Ridgecrest hypocenter and moment-tensor release
catalog.scientific_purpose: Long-term event-rate, relative-location, fault-orientation and focal-mechanism cross-check over changing network conditions.
catalog.event_definition: PhaseNO detections associated by GaMMA, absolutely located by HypoSVI, relatively relocated with GrowClust where sufficient correlation support exists, with a separate signed-P-amplitude moment-tensor subset.

catalog.quality_tier_detail: Long-term PhaseNO/GaMMA/HypoSVI/GrowClust and moment-tensor release; network and version effects matter.

construction_workflow.summary: PhaseNO detects P/S arrivals on a changing 66-station network; GaMMA associates them; HypoSVI provides absolute locations; GrowClust refines relative hypocenters; signed P amplitudes feed a separately filtered moment-tensor release.

input_data.name: Continuous multi-network 3C waveforms
input_data.temporal_spatial_scope: April 2019 through May 2023; broad 200 × 200 km region
input_data.channels_sampling: Three-component; above 1 Hz high-pass; changing availability
input_data.availability_conditions: Neural graph uses 18 stations; station-day inventory not locally extracted.

input_data.name: Signed P-wave amplitude measurements
input_data.availability_conditions: 226,615 measurements from 45,684 events reported in article.

stages.name: Neural P/S detection
stages.purpose: Generate phase arrivals from continuous waveforms.
stages.method: Apply PhaseNO to 3C data with above-1-Hz high-pass.

stages.name: GaMMA association
stages.purpose: Associate phase picks into event hypotheses.
stages.method: Use 10-s subwindows, minimum 15 picks and maximum phase error 2 s.
stages.dependencies: Depends on detected picks and station graph.

stages.name: Amplitude magnitudes and HypoSVI absolute locations
stages.purpose: Estimate source locations and station terms before relative relocation.
stages.method: Run HypoSVI with smoothed model and source-specific station terms for eight iterations.

parameters.name: uncertainty_target
parameters.value: 90 percent: horizontal below 700 m; vertical below 1 km

qc_and_rejection_rules: Retain QC fields qnpair, qndiff and RMS in release.
stages.intermediate_result: Article reports 90-percent uncertainty thresholds for retained non-relocated events.
stages.dependencies: Depends on GaMMA origins and velocity model.

stages.name: Waveform cross-correlation and GrowClust
stages.purpose: Refine relative event geometry where differential observations support clustering.
stages.method: Use waveform cross-correlation and GrowClust pairwise differential times.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Require CC at least 0.65 and at least 6 differential observations per pair.
stages.intermediate_result: Article: 214,467 retained relocated; local v2: 222,864 rows.
stages.dependencies: Depends on waveform overlap and station availability.

stages.name: Moment-tensor inversion and angular QC
stages.purpose: Invert tensors from signed P amplitudes and retain stable focal mechanisms.
stages.method: Invert tensors from signed P amplitudes; filter by pick count and strike/dip/rake standard deviations.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Retain candidates with at least 15 amplitudes and all angular standard deviations below 7.5 degrees.
stages.intermediate_result: Article: 7,645 candidates and 4,892 accepted; local: 4,890 accepted rows.
stages.dependencies: Requires amplitude signs, locations and uncertainty estimation.

construction_workflow.final_output: Local Version 2 contains 222,864 hypocenter rows and 4,890 accepted moment tensors; frozen common mask yields 5,737 and 254 respectively. Article counts (214,467 and 4,892) remain separate.

scientific_findings.statement: Fault orientation evolves through the sequence and long-term recovery; accepted moment tensors provide an orientation-focused subset rather than a complete event catalog.
Network and algorithm availability vary over years, so event-rate changes combine seismicity with observation-condition changes.

benchmark_context.quality_interpretation: Q2 long-term auxiliary overall; metric-specific Q1 for accepted relative geometry and moment-tensor uncertainty fields.
benchmark_context.recommended_role: Long-duration cross-check for relocation, focal mechanisms and method robustness; not the primary short-window hidden target.
benchmark_context.comparison_or_baseline_sources: Compare with Shelly, Liu and Ross only after restricting to the common July window and separating gamma magnitude from ML/Mw.
benchmark_context.valid_comparisons: Relative geometry, orientation, uncertainty calibration and long-term rate trends with explicit network/time conditioning.
benchmark_context.caveats: PhaseNO/GaMMA/HypoSVI/GrowClust overlap with likely Agent components; local Version 2 does not reproduce article counts without exact release manifest.
